subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should the read tool get a narrow fail-closed binary-document fallback now, or wait for the broader document extraction/native-file-input direction?
rationale: Current source still reproduces the token-waste path, but the issue offers both a simple safety guard and a broader parsing capability, and related Office/document issues carry security and product-scope implications.

options.title: Land narrow fallback
options.body: Implement a current-main guard that returns a structured unsupported-document message for common Office/PDF binary formats without adding parsers.

options.title: Wait for broader document support
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers choose the document extraction/native file architecture tracked by related media issues.

options.title: Move parsing out of core
options.body: Accept only the read safety guard in core and direct parser-style extraction to plugins or ClawHub unless a missing core API is proven.

recommendation.title: Land narrow fallback
recommendation.body: Implement a current-main guard that returns a structured unsupported-document message for common Office/PDF binary formats without adding parsers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main read-path blame and related issue triage make this the best available owner for the product-scope choice.
